### Email
📧 <strong>duli199982@gmail.com</strong><br>

<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" onclick="copyEmail()">
  Copy email
</button>

<script>
  function copyEmail() {
    const email = "duli199982@gmail.com";
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(email).then(() => {
      const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button[onclick="copyEmail()"]');
      btns.forEach(b => {
        const old = b.innerText;
        b.innerText = "Copied!";
        setTimeout(() => b.innerText = old, 1200);
      });
    }).catch(() => {
      const temp = document.createElement("textarea");
      temp.value = email;
      document.body.appendChild(temp);
      temp.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(temp);
      alert("Email copied: " + email);
    });
  }
</script>
